notes: *whatsoever* is given to the substantival article on the rendered participle (rule 41), with the unrendered `אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא` clause unrepresented under rule 22. Giving the word to the written relative instead was the live alternative.
`לַיהוָה` → *Jehovah's* fuses under rule 49's closing sentence, the copula staying with the written `הָיָה`.
The margin's *Or, whosoever* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
